description: Status filtering is computed once at mount from a ref captured in a `useMemo(..., [])` closure, so later status changes update the select and the URL but never narrow the rows (stale closure). Search still works. Trips only the critical status-filter test (expects 3 rows, gets 8). url-state-and-direct-load still passes because the URL is written correctly and the ref is seeded from `?status=delivered` on direct load; status-filter alone fails the gate.
